wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Yields Jump as Inflation Comes in Hotter Than Expected
wsjHeadlines.description: Nvidia stock slides for second straight day; Nasdaq falls 1%

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Founders’ Stakes Are Worth $18 Billion Apiece at IPO Price
wsjHeadlines.description: The seven insiders are each set to sell around $250 million worth of shares and keep total voting control.

wsjHeadlines.title: I’m Always Wrong About Gold. You Probably Are, Too.
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, what does fund “redemption” mean?

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic to Seek $1.3 Trillion Valuation in IPO
wsjHeadlines.description: The Claude maker’s stock-market debut is seen as a litmus test for investors on edge over the AI trade.

wsjHeadlines.title: CoreWeave Brings AI’s Financing Concern Into Focus
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Nvidia’s spy-scandal storm rages, and corporate America braces for investigations.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Nvidia Affair Is Terrible Timing for Corporate America
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus: Anthropic’s diminishing returns, energy inflation pass-throughs, and how AI could commodify work.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Pay Set to Climb After Volatile Markets and IPOs Fuel Bank Profits
wsjHeadlines.description: Traders and investment bankers are set to see among the biggest bumps in bonuses.

wsjHeadlines.title: A Reined In Jensen Huang Is Nvidia’s Best Option
wsjHeadlines.description: A more restrained chief would suit the chip giant well for the next phase of the AI boom.

wsjHeadlines.title: For Big Bank Stocks, Capitol Hill’s Bark Is Worse Than Its Bite
wsjHeadlines.description: Democrats’ election victory will put Wall Street critics in key seats, but the Fed holds the real power.

wsjHeadlines.title: DoorDash Shareholders Aren’t Convinced the Company Can Take On Amazon
wsjHeadlines.description: Following Instacart acquisition plans and an Amazon deal with rival Uber Eats, DoorDash stock is on sale.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Argument for Buying Treasury Bonds Is Still Strong
wsjHeadlines.description: As AI fears take down stocks, bonds offer compelling yields.

wsjHeadlines.title: How the Data Center Backlash Could Play Into the Hands of Big Tech
wsjHeadlines.description: Giants like Amazon and Microsoft stand to benefit from a shakeout.

wsjHeadlines.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on UniCredit, Credit Agricole, Banco BPM and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

wsjHeadlines.title: Norway’s Oil Fund Reaches $224.5 Million Settlement With KPMG Over SVB Collapse
wsjHeadlines.description: Norges Bank Investment Management and co-lead plaintiff Sjunde AP-fonden, Sweden’s state pension fund, reached a $224.5 million settlement in principle.

wsjHeadlines.title: Paraguay’s President Resigns as Collapse of Bank With Close Ties to Him Sparks Crisis
wsjHeadlines.description: Santiago Peña’s downfall rattled a fast-growing South American economy that has attracted investors and forged close ties with the U.S.

wsjHeadlines.title: Goldman’s Exclusive Club of Partners Welcomes Its Biggest Class Since 2010
wsjHeadlines.description: In a shift from previous years, the bank didn’t provide a gender or racial breakdown of the class.

wsjHeadlines.title: BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank  is expected to join its peers in raising borrowing costs Thursday, with the Fed, ECB and BoJ having each raised rates at least once since start of U.S.-Iran war.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. 10-Year Treasury Tops 5% on Expectations of Higher Interest Rates
wsjHeadlines.description: Treasury yields rose with the 10-year benchmark moving above 5%, as hotter-than-expected inflation added to hawkish comments by a Federal Reserve official to fuel bets on a steep interest-rate increase next month.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stocks Fall as Inflation Remains Elevated
wsjHeadlines.description: Stocks traded lower after data showed that inflation in October cooled from the month before, but still overshot expectations.

wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on oil futures, Adnoc Gas, Keyera and more in the latest Market Talks covering Energy and Utilities.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Alphabet, Nvidia, Anthropic and more in the latest Market Talks covering Technology, Media and Telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Basic Materials Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on Barrick Mining, gold futures and more in the latest Market Talks covering Basic Materials.

wsjHeadlines.title: Capitol Hill’s Bark Is Worse Than Its Bite for Bank Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: Some of the best analysis and insight on investing, the wealth-management business and more.

wsjHeadlines.title: Stoxx 600 on Track for Record Close as Oil Drop Buoys Sentiment
wsjHeadlines.description: The Europe-wide Stoxx 600 index was on track to close at its first record high since August, as lower oil prices and a broader market recovery lifted stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Asian Stocks Rise, Oil Eases on Hopes for Iran Conflict Resolution
wsjHeadlines.description: Regional markets rallied following Wall Street’s gains overnight, with chip-related suppliers shrugging off concerns around Nvidia.

wsjHeadlines.title: A New Generation of Traders Is Trapped in Asia’s Market Meltdown
wsjHeadlines.description: From high-school clubs to social-media influencers, Asia’s new stock traders face a brutal reality check.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Building Wealth Requires More Than Charity
wsjHeadlines.description: Handouts can’t scale to a whole nation. A market-based path to ownership can.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The U.K. Aims Sanctions at Israel, Hits the Cayman Islands
wsjHeadlines.description: Measures against the Jewish state’s banks could damage the financial-services industry in the British territory.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Trump, the New Congress and the Solyndra Probe
wsjHeadlines.description: The administration’s equity stakes in U.S. companies are about to draw legislative scrutiny.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | There’s No Such Thing as a Stock-Market Bubble
wsjHeadlines.description: In 1999, just as today, when share prices fall, it isn’t a delusion correcting. It’s uncertainty resolving.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Politics Shakes Up the Markets
wsjHeadlines.description: A tech correction could force Washington to focus on the economy.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | The Virgin Islands in Crisis
wsjHeadlines.description: Restarting an idled oil refinery isn’t a cure-all for the territory’s financial woes.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Decline After U.S. CPI Data
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures lost ground after U.S. consumer price inflation for October came in above estimates, pushing up yields and firming expectations for a Fed December interest-rate increase.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Extend Slide as Trump Indicates Restraint on Iran
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures extended Monday’s selloff after President Trump reiterated that it’s unlikely the U.S. will re-escalate its conflict with Iran.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Extend Gains
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures rose as a cold spell forecast for the weekend across the eastern U.S. lifted near-term demand expectations.

wsjHeadlines.title: Adnoc Gas Still Evaluating Options to Bypass Strait of Hormuz
wsjHeadlines.description: The company has been examining ways to reduce its reliance on the strait—including an LNG export facility on the country’s east coast—its chief executive says.

wsjHeadlines.title: Singapore Central Bank Rolls Out Gold-Vaulting Services
wsjHeadlines.description: The Monetary Authority of Singapore is rolling out gold-vaulting services as part of efforts to make the city-state Asia’s top gold-trading hub.

wsjHeadlines.title: Dollar Strengthens as Sticky Inflation Fuels Fed Hike Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: The dollar strengthened after hotter-than-expected October inflation data while the euro struggled on projections for weak eurozone growth.

wsjHeadlines.title: Yuan Rally Likely to Cool, Not Reverse
wsjHeadlines.description: China’s increase in banks’ foreign-exchange reserve requirements is aimed at slowing the yuan’s appreciation rather than reversing it, OCBC said.
